title: Balls or Gapes IV: Test Campaign, Batch 1 (turns 1-10 of 20, solo seat 1)

turns.title: Welcome to Staff Orientation
turns.text: Congratulations on your new job, which you did not apply for. Mags Thimbleby glares at you over the bar. Behind her, the Gullet door wheezes. A goblin bar-back named Splurt waves a mop at you like it's a sword. It is not a sword. Nothing here is what it should be.

options.label: Ask Mags what exactly the mimic ate.

success.text: Mags lists: the beer, the cellar, and Harold, her late husband, in a very nice urn. 'Bring Harold back. Beer optional.'

fail.text: Mags just says 'everything' and cries into a rag. Splurt fills you in, mostly wrongly.

success.text: The door has teeth. Polite teeth, but teeth. You notice it flinches at hot things.

fail.text: You poke it. It pokes back. With a tongue. You are now coated in tavern slobber, and everyone can smell it.

success.text: Splurt says he's 'Head of Security.' He's also Head of Mops and Head of Crying. He'll follow you down. You did not ask for this.

fail.text: Splurt says he's 'Head of Security.' He's also Head of Mops and Head of Crying. He'll follow you down. You did not ask for this.

turns.title: The Store Behind the Bar
turns.text: Mags opens a cabinet marked SUPPLIES. Inside: a shopping list of sad and expensive things. Shoes are sold out. Of course they are.

success.text: You buy things. Mags rings you up with the energy of someone whose bar is digesting her husband.

fail.text: You buy things. Mags rings you up with the energy of someone whose bar is digesting her husband.

success.text: She knocks off a gold piece 'because you have honest feet.'

fail.text: She raises prices. 'Grief tax.'

options.label: Pocket a free torch while she isn't looking.

success.text: Free torch. Splurt saw. Splurt respects you now.

fail.text: Mags saw. Mags adds it to your tab, with interest.

turns.title: Casing the Joint
turns.text: Heist rule one: case the place. The tavern regulars, all four of them, are still here because the mimic also ate the exit. Each has seen something.

options.label: Buy the old drunk a drink for gossip.

success.text: He says the mimic swallows everything into three stomachs, and the urn will be in the last one, where the shiny stuff goes.

fail.text: He tells you about his divorce. In detail. You learn nothing about mimics.

options.label: Draw a map from the mimic's burps.

success.text: Each burp echoes from a different chamber. You have a map. It smells.

fail.text: You have a drawing. It might be a duck.

options.label: Skip the planning. Plans are for cowards.

success.text: Bold. Stupid. Very you. Splurt applauds.

fail.text: Bold. Stupid. Very you. Splurt applauds.

turns.title: The Plan
turns.text: Heist rule two: make a plan. Splurt is already wearing a fake mustache. He has no part in the plan.

options.label: Plan A: go in hot (torch first).

success.text: The mimic hates heat, probably. You go with fire.

fail.text: The mimic hates heat, probably. You go with fire.

success.text: Sneak in, grab the urn, sneak out. What could go wrong. (Everything.)

fail.text: Sneak in, grab the urn, sneak out. What could go wrong. (Everything.)

options.label: Plan C: go in polite, with a bucket of beer as a peace offering.

success.text: Mimics are just furniture with feelings. You'll negotiate.

fail.text: Mimics are just furniture with feelings. You'll negotiate.

turns.title: Stomach One: The Lobby
turns.text: You climb down the throat. It's warm and moist, like a sauna run by a dog. A pair of Gut Rats (acid-proof, union members) block the way. They're chewing a barstool.

success.text: You kick one, the other runs. Small victory. The barstool is yours now.

fail.text: A rat bites your ankle. Your bare ankle.

success.text: Rats are reasonable. They eat. They let you pass. One gives you a salute.

fail.text: Rats are reasonable. They eat. They let you pass. One gives you a salute.

options.label: Pretend to be a health inspector.

success.text: The rats panic and scatter to file paperwork.

fail.text: They demand ID. You show them a mop. They are unimpressed.

turns.title: Stomach One: Lost and Found
turns.text: A pile of things the mimic swallowed and didn't like: boots (one, left, size baby), a love letter, a very angry cat in a jar.

success.text: The cat is grateful in its own way, which is ignoring you. It follows anyway.

fail.text: The cat scratches your face and leaves. Fair.

success.text: It's to Mags. From Harold. You all go quiet. Splurt sobs. You resolve to bring him home.

fail.text: It's to Mags. From Harold. You all go quiet. Splurt sobs. You resolve to bring him home.

success.text: It fits your big toe. Technically you now own shoes.

fail.text: You fall over. The mimic laughs. The whole room shakes.

turns.title: The Sphincter Door
turns.text: Between stomachs is a door. It's a sphincter. We're not going to talk about it. It's clenched.

success.text: Hot! The door spasms open. You go through with dignity. Some dignity.

fail.text: You singe your own eyebrows. The door laughs and opens anyway.

success.text: It giggles open. Never speak of this.

fail.text: It clenches harder. Splurt has to tickle it. He's good at it.

success.text: It opens. Manners matter, even inside a monster.

fail.text: It opens. Manners matter, even inside a monster.

turns.title: Stomach Two: The Bar Inside the Bar
turns.text: Things go wrong, as heists do. Stomach Two is a perfect copy of the tavern above, built of meat. The fake bartender is a Mimic Mini. It asks what you're having.

options.label: Order a drink to play along.

success.text: You spot that the bottles are teeth. You order 'nothing, thanks' and walk on by.

fail.text: You drink it. It's stomach acid with a lime. Ouch.

success.text: You flip the counter and it squeals off to sulk. Heist back on track.

fail.text: It bites. Big bite. You win, eventually, minus some skin.

success.text: Even mimics love a tip. It points the way to Stomach Three and winks with a drawer.

fail.text: Even mimics love a tip. It points the way to Stomach Three and winks with a drawer.

turns.title: Splurt's Big Moment
turns.text: Splurt trips on the rug, which is a tongue, and is lifted up toward the ceiling, which is a mouth. He screams 'I DON'T WANT TO BE AN EXTRA!'

success.text: Got him. He hugs you, uncomfortably long.

fail.text: You both go up. You both come down. Badly.

success.text: Snip. Splurt drops into your arms. The mimic groans. The tavern above shakes.

fail.text: You cut your own hair. Splurt still falls, onto you.

options.label: Let him go. He'll respawn. Probably.

success.text: Splurt disappears with a sad 'bloop'. Twenty minutes later he walks back in from upstairs, confused. Death is weird here.

fail.text: Splurt disappears with a sad 'bloop'. Twenty minutes later he walks back in from upstairs, confused. Death is weird here.

turns.title: The Glint Ahead
turns.text: Through the last throat you see it: Stomach Three, piled with every shiny thing the mimic ever ate, and on top, glowing gently, Harold's urn. Something big shifts beneath the pile. To be continued.

success.text: Fine. Bold. We'll see tomorrow.

fail.text: Fine. Bold. We'll see tomorrow.

success.text: Quiet feet. Your bare feet are finally useful.

fail.text: Quiet feet. Your bare feet are finally useful.

options.label: Call out to whatever's under the pile.

success.text: A deep voice says 'Who's there?' It has a lisp. Interesting.

fail.text: A deep voice says 'Who's there?' It has a lisp. Interesting.
